newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers no on-peak power for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers no on-peak power for Wednesday.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered no on-peak power for Wednesday schedulings while raising prices for off-peak offers by $2.00 to $3.50 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Tuesday.
BPA also limited firm offers during off-peak hours to 400 megawatts and non-firm volumes to 300 MW, compared with no limits on off-peak Tuesday sales.
The federal agency offered firm power during off-peak hours (0100-0600 and 230-2400 PST) on Wednesday at $19.00 per MWh for all deliveries, up from $16.00 for Tuesday.
Non-firm power, again for both Northwest and California-Oregon border deliveries, was offered at $18.50 for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400, up from $16.50.
Non-firm power during hours ending 0600 and 2300 on Wednesday was offered at $22.00 per MWh, compared with $18.50 for Tuesday.
